cases.scenario: Restore the service from backup after a server loss
cases.given: The latest backup of the database and file storage
cases.when: Restore onto a clean host following deploy/README.md
cases.then: Service back within 4 hours, losing at most 24 hours of data
cases.aiNote: Blocked: no restore drill has been done; backups are taken per deploy and kept on the same server, and the files and recordings volumes are not backed up (TC-SEC-009, SCRUM-215), so a lost server loses its backups and the RPO cannot be guaranteed. Stays Blocked until one restore drill is run.

cases.scenario: With the media server stopped, no speech worker or AI, and mail undeliverable, the rest keeps working
cases.given: LiveKit stopped; the speech worker and the local language model absent; @trustcabinet.local never mailed
cases.when: Sign in with a password; open the meeting list, a meeting's documents and votes; try to join an online meeting's room
cases.then: Sign-in and the meeting, document and voting screens work; the room says it cannot connect instead of failing silently
cases.aiNote: Measured: sign-in 200; list, documents and votes open; the lobby shows "Không kết nối được tới phòng họp. Vui lòng thử lại.". Emails queue in the outbox (SYS_WF09_TC02); a failed transcription keeps the audio (TC-REL-003). · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-185048 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.
